claims.title: Exact batch reuse: accepted source barriers and an independent-archive expected-cost obstruction

quoted_fields.interface: Original actual-row source-only exact-product model, plus THIS restricted theorem: choose a.s. finite K>=0 independently of the ENTIRE P stream, including old rows, possibly using independent bits or Q-only information. Draw and PAY K actual fresh P rows. Require universal law(Y|K=k)=Q^m for EVERY positive-probability k and every fixed P,Q. Unlimited Q calls/computation allowed. The extra conditional-exactness assumption is NOT part of the full minimax problem; actual K calls are charged, not unused random budgets.
quoted_fields.failure: Complete RESTRICTED expected-cost theorem with P-stream independence of ACTUAL archive size and EXTRA exactness conditional at EACH size. It is NOT an expected lower bound for all admissible batch algorithms, P-dependent stopping, exactness obtained only after mixing over stopping events, or arbitrary joint output corrections. The accepted one-row O(d/eta) factory remains valid outside this representation. Full minimax is OPEN. Prior mathematical operations count once. No Capital scientific execution/audit, new novelty/practical claim, source recovery/ZIP or resource change. All known/unknown holds and native-model unverified status persist.
